description: Request identity, supersession, cancellation, timeout and stale responses. Every request captures a target token; a response is accepted only if every token field still matches. Each step gives the expected client state. Revised after Advaita's review of PR #3 (item 2).

steps.expected: req-A is aborted at once: 'Sketch changed, so the interpretation was cancelled.' Source and scene are kept.

steps.event: A response for req-A still arrives (the network raced the abort)
steps.expected: Discarded: req-A is no longer pending and sourceRevision 10 ≠ 11. Scene unchanged.

steps.event: User clicks Interpret again before req-B returns
steps.expected: req-B is aborted and marked superseded; only req-C can be accepted.
req-C is aborted. Source and scene are kept. Note: 'Cancelled. The provider may still charge for this request.' Interpret is available again.

steps.event: Interpret (req-D); the provider does not respond
steps.expected: At 40 s (30 s after sending) req-D is aborted: 'The model did not respond in 30 s.' Retry is a separate button; nothing is retried automatically.

steps.event: Interpret (req-E) at sceneRevision 6, sourceRevision 11. Before it returns, the user drags a block in the preview (sceneRevision 6 → 7, source unchanged).
steps.expected: req-E is aborted when the edit applies; a late response is discarded because sceneRevision 6 ≠ 7 even though sourceRevision still matches. The manually edited scene (revision 7) is kept. This is the overwrite case from Advaita's review.

steps.event: Interpret (req-F) with epoch 3. The user presses Reset (epoch 3 → 4); the revisions do not change.
steps.expected: req-F is aborted; a late response is discarded because epoch 3 ≠ 4.

steps.event: Interpret (req-G) in exp-1 (sceneRevision 7, sourceRevision 11, epoch 4). The user switches to exp-2, which also happens to be at sceneRevision 7 and sourceRevision 11.
steps.expected: req-G is aborted; a late response is discarded because experimentId exp-1 ≠ exp-2 and epoch 4 ≠ 5. Matching revision numbers are not enough. exp-2's scene is unchanged.

steps.event: User reopens a saved version v-2 of exp-1 while command cmd-1 (target versionId v-1) is pending
steps.expected: cmd-1 is aborted; any late intent is discarded (versionId and epoch differ). Nothing is applied.

steps.event: Command cmd-2 is sent at sceneRevision 7; the user drags a block (revision 8) before the intent returns
steps.expected: cmd-2 is aborted. If a batch built for revision 7 still reaches the validator, it is rejected with STALE_REVISION. Nothing is applied and the user is asked to repeat the command.
